title: The Breeder
subtitle: An advancement by one criterion
description: `criterion` narrows an advancement task to one of the advancement's own criteria rather than the whole thing. `minecraft:husbandry/breed_an_animal` is earned by breeding a pair; the criterion named here is the one that fires when you do.
The advancement condition on the shepherd's tally in the clockwork arm asks the same question the other way round — as a gate on a reward rather than a task.
